newsitem.title: USA: China buys at least 44,000 T US soyoil - exporters.
newsitem.headline: China buys at least 44,000 T US soyoil - exporters.

text.p: China is said to have bought at least 44,000 tonnes of U.S. soybean oil Tuesday for prompt shipment, export sources said.
Some in the trade estimated that Chinese purchases this week totalled as much as 70,000 tonnes.
"It's not a rumor," said one exporter with ties to China. "I can assure you 70,000 tonnes has been done."
Another soyoil exporter said China was putting together the purchase of another 35,000 tonnes for November shipment.
At 1214 CST, December soyoil was up 0.11 cent per pound at 22.83, and January was up 0.10 cent at 23.08.
